leftEvidence.title: The man becomes living through divine breath

points.label: Recipient
points.left: One human is formed and becomes living.
points.right: Many creatures live, die, and are renewed.

points.label: Breath / Spirit
points.left: God breathes the breath of life into the human.
points.right: Breath is withdrawn in death and Spirit sent in creation/renewal.

points.label: Time
points.left: The focus is formation at the human beginning.
points.right: The focus is ongoing creature dependence.

payload.posture: Notice the repeated breath/life relationship while respecting the different scales of the two passages.

rightEvidence.title: Creatures depend on breath and are renewed when Spirit is sent

payload.tension: Genesis describes one human receiving breath and becoming alive, while Psalm 104 describes many creatures dying and being renewed when Spirit is sent.
payload.title: Breath gives life / Spirit renews life
